_comment: Raw aluminium: mill-finish aluminium sheet, plate or extrusion as it leaves the rolls or the die, with no brushing, polishing or anodising: a bright, pale silver with a soft, hazy reflection (structural sections, posts, trims, thresholds, flashings). Opaque, param-only: a solid metal with no texture of its own at this scale; the finish is the roughness. Base colour from Physically Based 'Aluminum'. The plain sibling of Aluminium_Brushed: it has no specular anisotropy, so it renders the same in a tool that does not carry anisotropy. APPROXIMATE: OpenPBR's metal edge tint (specular_color, the F82 tint) and the complex IOR are not carried by the library (F-LC-6), so the reflectance toward grazing angles is the base colour's Schlick fade, not aluminium's measured one. Carries every relevant wear layer at 0 (C1): hairline scratches (overlay 1, damage), dust as a deposit (Phase10), fingerprints, gated by the Edges mask (its B channel is the broad corner band meant for a deposit, its A the open faces meant for handling marks, so dust takes slot 2 and fingerprints slot 3). Not carried: the tarnish colour the wish list also wants. Built for the platform's generated architectural Set (261004_R_PlatformSetMaterialAsks.md, A1 and SM-Q1).
name: Aluminium_Raw_Clean_Base_s01_v01

sources.note: roughness_const is not taken (the entry is an ideal mirror); the mill finish is the judgement below.

sources.why: roughness 0.3 for a mill finish: the rolled or extruded face reflects a bright sky as a soft glow with no readable image, clearly metal and not a mirror; between a polished sheet (0.1, StainlessSteel_Polished) and the brushed sibling's 0.34. No measured value.
